description_en: One rattan and bamboo household product. Front: A single narrow woven rail contains two concave bamboo saddles for resting chopsticks. Side: The two saddles are lifted above a low solid base. Rear: The rear reveals the bound ends of the saddle rods and a smooth back rail. Smooth bound joints, visibly interlaced natural fibers, empty clean inserts where specified. No writing, numbers, logos, marks, labels or other objects.
